mapper.select: SELECT id, batch_id, location_id, in_qty, out_qty FROM ph_inv_flow WHERE tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0' AND biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_no = #{bizNo} AND biz_line_id = #{bizLineId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, status FROM ph_warehouse WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT l.id, l.warehouse_id, l.max_capacity, l.status FROM ph_location l JOIN ph_warehouse w ON w.id = l.warehouse_id AND w.tenant_id = l.tenant_id WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND l.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND w.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND l.deleted = b'0' AND w.deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) FROM ph_inv_location_stock s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND s.location_id = #{locationId} AND s.deleted = b'0'

SELECT id, warehouse_id, drug_id, batch_no, manufacture_date, expiry_date, quality_status, qty_total, qty_avail, qty_frozen, qty_sold, cost_price FROM ph_inv_batch WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, warehouse_id, drug_id, batch_no, manufacture_date, expiry_date, quality_status, qty_total, qty_avail, qty_frozen, qty_sold, cost_price FROM ph_inv_batch WHERE tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND drug_id = #{drugId} AND batch_no = #{batchNo} AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id, s.batch_id, s.location_id, s.drug_id, s.qty, s.qty_frozen, b.warehouse_id, b.batch_no, b.expiry_date, b.quality_status, b.qty_total AS batch_total, b.qty_avail AS batch_avail, b.qty_frozen AS batch_frozen, b.qty_sold AS batch_sold FROM ph_inv_location_stock s JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = s.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = s.tenant_id JOIN ph_location l ON l.id = s.location_id AND l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND l.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id JOIN ph_warehouse w ON w.id = b.warehouse_id AND w.tenant_id = b.tenant_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND b.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND b.drug_id = #{drugId} AND s.deleted = b'0' AND b.deleted = b'0' AND l.deleted = b'0' AND w.deleted = b'0' AND w.status = 1 AND l.status = 1 AND b.quality_status = 0 AND b.expiry_date >= #{today} ORDER BY b.expiry_date, b.id, s.location_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id, s.batch_id, s.location_id, s.drug_id, s.qty, s.qty_frozen FROM ph_inv_location_stock s JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = s.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = s.tenant_id JOIN ph_location l ON l.id = s.location_id AND l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND l.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id WHERE s.batch_id = #{batchId} AND s.location_id = #{locationId} AND s.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND b.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND s.deleted = b'0' AND b.deleted = b'0' AND l.deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ph_inv_batch (tenant_id, store_id, warehouse_id, drug_id, batch_no, manufacture_date, expiry_date, source_type, qty_total, qty_avail, qty_frozen, qty_sold, quality_status, expiry_status, cost_price, version, creator, updater) VALUES (#{scope.tenantId}, #{scope.storeId}, #{warehouseId}, #{drugId}, #{batchNo}, #{manufactureDate}, #{expiryDate}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{operator}, #{operator}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)

INSERT INTO ph_inv_location_stock (tenant_id, batch_id, location_id, drug_id, qty, qty_frozen, creator, updater) VALUES (#{scope.tenantId}, #{batchId}, #{locationId}, #{drugId}, 0, 0, #{operator}, #{operator}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.update: UPDATE ph_inv_location_stock SET qty = qty + #{qty}, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE ph_inv_batch SET cost_price = CASE WHEN qty_total + #{qty} = 0 THEN cost_price ELSE (cost_price * qty_total + #{unitPrice} * #{qty}) / (qty_total + #{qty}) END, qty_total = qty_total + #{qty}, qty_avail = qty_avail + #{qty}, version = version + 1, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE ph_inv_location_stock SET qty = qty - #{qty}, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0' AND qty - qty_frozen >= #{qty}

UPDATE ph_inv_batch SET qty_total = qty_total - #{qty}, qty_avail = qty_avail - #{qty}, qty_sold = qty_sold + #{qty}, last_issue_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0' AND qty_avail >= #{qty} AND qty_total - #{qty} >= qty_frozen
UPDATE ph_inv_location_stock SET qty = qty + #{qty}, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ph_inv_flow (tenant_id, store_id, batch_id, drug_id, batch_no, flow_type, in_qty, out_qty, balance_qty, biz_type, biz_no, biz_line_id, original_flow_id, flow_time, operator, creator, updater, location_id, frozen_delta, unit_cost) VALUES (#{scope.tenantId}, #{scope.storeId}, #{flow.batchId}, #{flow.drugId}, #{flow.batchNo}, #{flow.flowType}, #{flow.inQty}, #{flow.outQty}, #{flow.balanceQty}, #{flow.bizType}, #{flow.bizNo}, #{flow.bizLineId}, #{flow.originalFlowId}, #{flow.flowTime}, #{flow.operator}, #{flow.operator}, #{flow.operator}, #{flow.locationId}, 0, #{flow.unitCost})
